selection.note: every LongMemEval-S question, sorted by question_id; abstention questions are retrieved but not scored

document_unit.rule: one user turn plus the assistant turns that follow it; leading assistant turns form their own round
document_unit.blank_rounds: blank (whitespace-only) rounds are not indexed by any arm; round IDs stay positional, so every other round's ID and the gold are unchanged; the count is recorded per question as blank_rounds_skipped

arms.store: plain round bodies, no embedder, no projection (v1 shape)

variants.method: Engine.search_text_only on the same store, reopened with EngineConfig.query_stop_words (REQ41-Q8)

arms.store: the same plain round bodies plus ProjectionSpec(name='dense', SEARCHABLE, vector=True) declared before writes; the full node body is embedded; vector coverage checked per store

variants.method: Engine.search on the same store, reopened with EngineConfig.query_stop_words (REQ41-Q8)

arms.method: table.search(query_type='fts'), native FTS index, library defaults

retrieval.store: fresh store per question per arm, removed after
retrieval.limits: each store is queried at top_k (timed, five repeats) and at every extra_limits value (ids_at, for the Slice 41 M1 evaluator, which needs each policy's own k because hybrid is not prefix-stable)
retrieval.variants: a variant reopens its arm's store after the default queries, with its engine_config, and is scored as its own arm; its store build is the parent's, so it differs from the parent only by the query setting; its timings follow a warm reopen and are not comparable to the parent's first-query latency

bootstrap.ci: 2.5th and 97.5th percentile of paired mean differences

metrics.latency: first query and five repeats per store; hybrid query latency includes embedding the question

device.cuda_fallback: refused: a cuda:N request must resolve to an effective CUDA device with a selected UUID

claim_boundary.statement: adopt hybrid for the answer run iff (a) preference session Recall@5 delta CI lower bound > 0, (b) no other type's delta CI upper bound < 0, (c) overall delta >= 0
claim_boundary.reason: EARP found hybrid null-or-negative on real traces, so adoption is decided by this pre-stated rule
claim_boundary.scope: retrieval only; no answerer or judge
claim_boundary.slice41: the stop-word variants and ids_at serve Slice 41 MQ1, MQ2 and M1; the decision rule still compares the default fathomdb-hybrid and fathomdb-fts arms

mq1.pass: REQ41 MQ1: for every question, the variant's top-10 equals the harness transform's top-10 (comp03_unit_h.simulated_query on the same store opened with the defaults); 500 of 500. The engine list's hash must equal the installed DEFAULT_STOP_WORDS_SHA256.
mq1.informative: the count of questions whose variant top-10 equals the stoplist verdict's simulated_fts_ids (simulated at engine 5b09afd44); a difference there is a head difference, not a Unit Q defect
